sql:
SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(c.client_id) * 100 AS male_percentage
FROM 
    client c
JOIN 
    district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE 
    d.A3 = 'South Bohemia'
ORDER BY 
    d.A4 DESC
LIMIT 1
